title: Data Type Debugger
prompt:
Write a program that declares and initializes variables of different data types (integer, float, string, boolean) and then prints out their values and data types. Ensure the variables are named appropriately to reflect their contents.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: Variable: age, Value: 25, Type: int
Variable: height, Value: 1.75, Type: float
Variable: name, Value: John Doe, Type: str
Variable: isAdmin, Value: True, Type: bool
answer:
Here's a Python program that meets your requirements:

```python
# Declare and initialize variables of different data types
age = 25  # int
height = 1.75  # float
name = "John Doe"  # str
isAdmin = True  # bool

# Print out the values and data types of the variables
print(f"Variable: age, Value: {age}, Type: int")
print(f"Variable: height, Value: {height}, Type: float")
print(f"Variable: name, Value: {name}, Type: str")
print(f"Variable: isAdmin, Value: {isAdmin}, Type: bool")
```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
Variable: age, Value: 25, Type: int
Variable: height, Value: 1.75, Type: float
Variable: name, Value: John Doe, Type: str
Variable: isAdmin, Value: True, Type: bool
```
